scope: stage 4 fixed-split BC training and paired held-out closed-loop evaluation

protocol.model_selection: one predeclared baseline; no tuning on final evaluation
protocol.conditions: 3 shapes x 0/10/20 degrees; azimuth (i%4)*90; same 30 layouts reused across 9 conditions

dataset_validation.checks: checksum, schema, finite values, action bounds, episode continuity, transitions, successful-only, disjoint seed split, closed-start recovery

validation_analysis.note: Teacher phase is an analysis label only, never a BC input; held-out demonstration frames, not closed-loop performance.

iid.layout_reuse: same seeds across all nine shape/tilt conditions

recovery.layout_reuse: same seeds across all nine shape/tilt conditions
